parsed.basis: Plaisance, in the greater Victoria area of Mahé, shares Seychelles' national legal position for a transgender visitor who is outed: same-sex conduct was decriminalised in 2016 and is not an offence, the constitution protects against torture and guarantees equal protection, and 2024 amendments add gender identity to hate-crime protections with enhanced penalties for bias-motivated violence. No region-specific information distinguishes Plaisance from the national picture in relation to border practice, policing, facilities or social treatment, and no distinct local enforcement pattern is documented for this district.
